name: SiteChat – Live Chat, AI Chatbot and Visitor Insights for your Website
author: sitechat

sections.description:
SiteChat is a Live Chat + AI Chatbot Mobile App for your website that turns your site into an interactive, smart assistant. With SiteChat, you can:

  • Track live visitors: See who’s on your site right now, what they’re doing, and where they came from.
  • Chat with your visitors: Engage with your visitors via AI-powered chatbot, instantly answering questions and helping them navigate your site.
  • Mobile notifications: If the chatbot can’t answer a question, you’ll be notified on your mobile so you can take over the chat.
  • Voice and text interaction: Ask your website what’s been happening, see key insights, and have a conversation with your website like never before!
  • Train the chatbot: The chatbot looks at your entire website and can answer questions on anything that’s on there.

The best part? It’s simple to set up:
Just download the app to your mobile, install the SiteChat plugin, paste in your SiteChat Link Code, and you’re ready to go live. No coding required!

👉 Watch a 1-minute demo
👉 Get SiteChat from Google Play
👉 Get SiteChat from The Apple App Store
👉 Or use the SiteChat Web App

Why Website Owners Love SiteChat:

  • Instant customer support: Connect with your visitors before they leave your site.
  • Track user behavior: Understand what visitors are doing, what they’re interested in, and where they’re dropping off.
  • Seamless live chat: Your team can take over chats on mobile, providing human assistance when needed.
  • Daily updates: Keep up with your site’s performance, traffic, and interactions all from your phone!

Start with a 14-day free trial – no credit card required.

Get the App and Free Trial

👉 Download the SiteChat app and start your 14-day free trial today!
– Download on the App Store
– Get it on Google Play

External Services

This plugin integrates with the SiteChat app, a powerful AI chatbot and live visitor tracking platform. It adds a script to your website that connects to the SiteChat API at remote.sitechatapp.com.

By using SiteChat, you agree to the terms outlined in our Terms of Use and Privacy Policy.
sections.installation:
1. Install the plugin via the WordPress Plugin Directory or upload to /wp-content/plugins/
  2. Activate the plugin via the Plugins menu
  3. Go to Settings → SiteChat and paste your SiteChat app link code (you get this from the SiteChat app)
sections.faq:
Do I need to download the SiteChat App?

You can either download the App, or simply use the Web app at getsitechat.com. Getting started is quick and easy.

Where do I find my SiteChat link code?

Once logged into the SiteChat app, click on the Website tab, select your website, and then click Add to your Website. Choose WordPress to get the link code.
